answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a refundable deposit locked for a full epoch, like a pearl held in escrow on a shared terrace: creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive because every identity must fund its own stake, while honest agents recover theirs. A light reputation signal — a zephyr of attestations from peers who verified real work — then weights rewards, so a flood of fresh, unproven identities earns almost nothing until it has done costly, verifiable work.
